items.q: Benny Goodman, or somebody, you know. Which did not happen. You didn't know those people. They didn't call anybody.

ctx.x: Well once you found a place to live, how did you make out finding a job?

Now, I think I can -- so I started looking around for, you know -- well at that time, gigs, you'd get a gig, five, six dollars a night. If you got into a ten dollar gig, man, you must have known Paul Whiteman! Or somebody, you know. Benny Goodman, or somebody, you know. Which did not happen. You didn't know those people. They didn't call anybody. So I started messing around, and the guy would call, and I'd introduce myself here and there, and back --
You'd go around to the clubs and just --
